title: H.H. Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan meets the Prime Minister
body_text: H.H. Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, UAE, met Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi yesterday. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "H.H. Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, UAE met Prime Minister @narendramodi yesterday." H.H.
